process_description: CANONICAL document sorting/classification via process_uploaded_document(). Creates FILEDORED overlay with filedored_path in payload. Caller MUST pass a constructed UnifiedOverlayManager (no lazy init). AI classification is optional (enable_ai flag). FORBIDDEN: vault_id/user_id/overlay_path/overlay_data on CreateOverlayRequest. CANONICAL folder creation via ensure_filedored_folders() and ensure_filedored_folder(). Base folders created upfront; AI subdirectories lazy-created on demand. Redis flag (30-day TTL) prevents redundant API calls. POST /process POST /folders/status GET /browse/{folder:path} GET /folders Health check for filedored module.
